items.title: 68091_Joe Turner oral history interview
items.q: I made a number about Piney Brown 'cause I used to work for him all the time, and we worked on...we worked on Twelfth Street-- Twelfth and Highland--to a nightclub called the Sunset Club.

ctx.x: You met Pete when you started working at the...

I met Pete when I was a young man but we went... John Hammond, after we moved to Twelfth Street... We move out on Twelfth Street, a joint called the Sunset Club, and they had a fellow runnin' it called Piney Brown.
And later on, when I went to New York City...I'm jumpin' ahead of myself.
